construction_notes.text: From the state Housing Element Annual Progress Report, through 2025.

City of San Jose permit MP24-009 (Ministerial Permit, folder year 2024), status Approved, issue date 2025-07-18: "SB 35 Ministerial Permit to allow a 100% affordable housing development (50% of units at 80% AMI) consisting of 45 for-sale townhome style condominium units, the removal of 73 trees, including 41 ordinance-size trees, and a request for 8 Density Bonus w" (city text cut off at 255 characters)

City of San Jose permit PRE24-125 (Prelim - Focused (Policy Review, No Plans), folder year 2024), status Complete: "SB 330 Preliminary Application for an affordable for-sale townhouse development consisting of approximately 45 homes with surface parking for guests, trash enclosures, and landscaped open space, on a 3.03-ac site. (APNs: 462-02-028, 462-02-026, 462-02-024" (city text cut off at 255 characters)

City of San Jose permit T24-037 (Tentative Map, folder year 2024), status Preparing for Hearin, issue date 2025-07-18: "Vesting Tentative Map to merge four lots into one lot for a condominium subdivision (45 townhomes), private streets, and creation of separate parcel for utility purposes, on a 2.98-acre site."

Developer site: 31 three-bedroom townhomes of about 1,268 sq ft and 14 four-bedroom townhomes of about 2,121 sq ft; three units fully accessible; HOA dues expected about $450/month; sales prices not finalized; buyer orientation early 2027, buyer and lot selection tentatively spring 2027, completion expected by summer 2028.
January-February 2025 reporting: construction targeted to begin by 2027 and opening by 2029; Charities Housing to manage the property once built.
Charities Housing development pipeline lists the Branham Ave Homeownership Project (San Jose, homeownership townhomes) under Predevelopment.
State APR 2024 Table A lists MP24-009 at 4747 Narvaez Rd as 45 owner-occupied single-family attached units, submitted 2024-10-15 under SB 423 (2023), ministerial, density bonus received.
